8 Best 11.11 Sale Deals in Singapore (2026): Shopee, HipVan, Castlery, Secretlab and Every Offer Already Live | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 Deals 8 Best 11.11 Sale Deals in Singapore (2026): Shopee, HipVan, Castlery, Secretlab and Every Offer Already Live
 11.11 lands on Wednesday 11 November, but half the good deals start (and some end) before it. We checked eight brands' own sites on 30 October: Shopee's vouchers are already dropping, HipVan's EARLY11 ends 2 November and Castlery's tiers end 4 November.
 Marcus Wong 30 October 2026 7 min read Updated 31 Oct 2026 The biggest online sale of the year lands on Wednesday 11 November, and the early birds are already flying. 
 > Quick view: act first on HipVan's EARLY11 (ends 2 Nov) and Castlery's tiers (end 4 Nov) ; Shopee's $111 off $350 voucher tops up through the day. The trap: the 11 Nov-only deals sell out within hours. 
 1 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale: the widest pool, vouchers from $111 off $350 already dropping
 Shopee switched its campaign page to the 2026 sale on 30 October, and the vouchers are real this time, each marked valid from 30 Oct. THE VOUCHERS: an all-categories $111 off a $350 minimum spend , 20% off capped at $65 (min. $150) and 20% off capped at $250 (min. $500), plus 15% coins cashback capped at 1,500 coins on a $15 minimum. Free shipping applies from a $15 spend for all sellers, and Shopee Live adds category vouchers such as 20% off capped at $12 on $35 of fashion. FINE PRINT: the big vouchers were already marked fully redeemed when we looked, with a countdown to the next top-up, so the pools refill in waves rather than lasting all day. Claim them from the campaign page before you shop, then stack a store voucher and a bank-card promo on top. The page title also promises an extra 3% cashback for ShopeeVIP members. TIMING: the main event is Wednesday 11 November ; expect the deepest drops at midnight, noon and 8pm. BEST FOR: everyday items, electronics accessories and anything you can compare across sellers at the final checkout price. 
 11.11 Big Sale vouchers valid from 30 Oct 2026: $111 off $350, 20% off capped at $65 (min. $150), 20% off capped at $250 (min. $500), 15% coins cashback capped at 1,500 coins (min. $15), free shipping from $15. Pools top up in waves; main day Wed 11 Nov.
 Valid till 11 Nov 2026
 Claim Shopee 11.11 vouchers 2 HipVan 11.11 Early Bird: code EARLY11 for 11% off storewide, ends 2 November
 The deadline that comes first on this list. THE DEAL: code EARLY11 takes 11% off storewide on a $250 minimum spend , and HipVan's own banner says it runs until 2 November . FINE PRINT: the minimum spend is counted on the final cart after all discounts; promotional and clearance items count towards it and also take the code; only one promo code works per order. No maximum discount is printed, so a $1,299 Nagomi Holly 3-seater swivel sofa saves about $143. DELIVERY: free over $300 , GST is absorbed and returns run 100 days, which is why HipVan often wins on a one- or two-piece order. New subscribers can sign up for a welcome offer of up to 16% off a first order instead, so compare before you check out. SHOWROOM: Blk B #01-08, Clarke Quay. BEST FOR: a sofa, dining set or a few decor pieces bought this weekend rather than on 11.11 itself. 
 11.11 Early Bird to 2 Nov 2026: code EARLY11 for 11% off storewide, min. spend $250 (final cart after discounts; clearance and promo items included; one code per order). Free delivery over $300.
 Code: EARLY11 
 Valid till 2 Nov 2026
 Shop the HipVan Early Bird 3 Castlery 11.11 Sale: up to $770 off storewide plus a free accessory, ends 4 November
 The strongest offer here for a big furniture basket. THE TIERS: $120 off $1,500 , $250 off $3,000 , $550 off $5,000 and $770 off $7,000 , applied automatically at one checkout, plus up to 40% off sale picks . Spend $2,500 or more and a selected accessory worth up to $60 is free (rugs, mirrors, bedding, sofa covers and care kits are excluded). DATES: Castlery's promo terms set the window at 26 October 00:00 to 4 November 23:59 . FINE PRINT: the spend is counted before shipping, so a $1,400 order gets nothing from the tiers; check each listing's warehouse date (many sofas say they leave by 6 November, some beds not until December). ALSO ON: Castlery's first sleep pop-up runs at Jurong Point from 2 to 15 November with up to S$150 off. BEST FOR: a full living room or a sofa-plus-table order of $3,000 or more, placed before 4 November. 
 11.11 Sale, 26 Oct 00:00 to 4 Nov 2026 23:59: $120 off $1,500, $250 off $3,000, $550 off $5,000, $770 off $7,000 (automatic, before shipping) plus up to 40% off sale picks; free selected accessory worth up to $60 on $2,500+.
 Valid till 4 Nov 2026
 See the Castlery 11.11 Sale 4 Secretlab 11.11 Sale: up to $300 off chairs and desks, ends 12 November at 2pm
 Secretlab's sale is already running and outlasts 11.11 by a day. THE DEAL: the site banner promises up to $300 off select products and up to an extra $120 off with a minimum spend . The sale clock on its product pages counts down to 12 November 2026, 2pm SGT . PRICES WE SAW: the MAGNUS Evo sit-to-stand desk is S$664 (U.P. S$699). CODES: the sale terms list SLEV-MINSW111126 for $120 off a $1,999 spend sitewide , SLEV-MINC111126 for $40 off $999 with an eligible chair and SLEV-MIND111126 for $60 off $1,599 with an eligible desk, plus SLEV-MEPP111126 for $48 off the Evo with its Performance preset accessories (min. $1,249). FINE PRINT: the extra-off codes are tied to bundles, so build the cart first and see which code the checkout accepts. BEST FOR: a home-office upgrade, pairing a TITAN Evo chair with a MAGNUS desk to clear the code thresholds. 
 11.11 Sale to 12 Nov 2026, 2pm SGT: up to $300 off select products and up to an extra $120 off with a min. spend. MAGNUS Evo S$664 (U.P. S$699). Codes: SLEV-MINSW111126 $120 off $1,999 sitewide; SLEV-MINC111126 $40 off $999 with a chair; SLEV-MIND111126 $60 off $1,599 with a desk.
 Code: SLEV-MINSW111126 
 Valid till 12 Nov 2026
 Shop the Secretlab sale 5 Weavve Home 11.11 Sale: code 11NOV15 for 15% off sitewide, to 15 November
 The local bedding and towel brand runs the longest window in this guide. THE DEAL: code 11NOV15 takes 15% off sitewide from 28 October to 15 November , and selected items are marked up to 45% off . BUNDLES: a run of 11.11 Special bundles (bamboo towel sets with a soy candle and reed diffuser, or a Signature TENCEL classic set with a lyocell duvet from $549) saves up to 24% . FINE PRINT: codes do not stack with other codes, so a bundle price and 11NOV15 may not combine; check the cart. Delivery is free within Singapore on orders above $50 . BEST FOR: a TENCEL sheet set or a full towel refresh before the year-end guests arrive. 
 11.11 Sale, 28 Oct-15 Nov 2026: code 11NOV15 for 15% off sitewide; up to 45% off selected items; 11.11 Special bundles up to 24% off. Codes not stackable. Free delivery above $50.
 Code: 11NOV15 
 Valid till 15 Nov 2026
 Shop the Weavve 11.11 Sale 6 Lenskart 11.11: Buy 1 Get 1 Free plus 11% off Essentials frames, reading glasses $11
 The cheapest way on this list to get two pairs of prescription glasses. THE DEAL: Lenskart's promotions page tags its Essentials frames, listed at S$100 with free lenses , as Buy 1 Get 1 Free + 11% Off with code 1111 , so two complete pairs come to roughly S$89 . The same tag sits on the Le Petit Lunetier range (S$150). READING GLASSES: non-power readers are S$11 including lenses , down from S$25. FINE PRINT: no end date is printed, so treat it as an 11.11 offer that can change without notice; lens upgrades (thinner, blue-light, progressive) cost extra. BEST FOR: anyone due a new prescription, or a spare pair for the office drawer. 
 11.11 offer, checked 31 Oct 2026: Essentials frames (S$100 with free lenses) Buy 1 Get 1 Free + 11% off with code 1111, about S$89 for two; non-power reading glasses S$11 including lenses (was S$25). No end date printed.
 See Lenskart's 11.11 frames 7 BEST Denki 11.11 TV Pre-Sale: early-bird big screens, Sony 75-inch Mini LED $3,999
 The electronics chain has opened an 11.11 TV Pre-Sale row on its homepage and online promotions page. PRICES ON 30 OCTOBER: Sony 75-inch Mini LED K-75XR50 $3,999 (was $6,299), Sony 48-inch OLED XR-48A90K $2,499 (was $4,037), Sony 85-inch K-85S30 $3,249 (was $5,799), Philips 65-inch QLED 65PQT8530 $999 (was $1,456), LG 50-inch QNED 50QNED82 $899 (was $1,199), Toshiba 43-inch QLED $849 and a Philips 43-inch LED for $369 . The Samsung Freestyle projector sits in the same row at $699 (was $1,499). FINE PRINT: no end date or terms are printed for the pre-sale, and the 'was' prices are BEST Denki's own list prices, so compare the model number at COURTS and Harvey Norman before you pay. BEST FOR: a big-screen TV bought before the year-end holidays without waiting for 11 November. 
 11.11 TV Pre-Sale, checked 30 Oct 2026: Sony 75" Mini LED K-75XR50 $3,999 (was $6,299), Sony 48" OLED $2,499 (was $4,037), Philips 65" QLED $999, LG 50" QNED $899, Samsung Freestyle $699 (was $1,499). No end date printed.
 See the 11.11 TV Pre-Sale 8 Wild Wild Wet 11.11: two off-peak adult Day Passes for $29, only on 11 November
 The one on-the-day deal worth setting an alarm for. THE DEAL: on Wednesday 11 November 2026 from 11am , Wild Wild Wet sells 1-for-1 off-peak adult Day Passes, two for $29 , which is $14.50 a head against the usual $29 each. WHEN YOU CAN USE THEM: both passes must be used on the same visit date , between 11 and 20 November 2026 or 1 January and 31 March 2027 . FINE PRINT: not combinable with other promotions or vouchers, no LinkPoints, and the passes are non-refundable and non-transferable. The park is closed on Tuesdays, and from 21 November the year-end school holidays turn every open day into peak, which is why the passes skip December. BEST FOR: couples and friends planning a cheap weekday splash in mid-November or early 2027. 
 11.11 only: from 11am on 11 Nov 2026, 1-for-1 off-peak adult Day Passes, two for $29. Same visit date, 11-20 Nov 2026 or 1 Jan-31 Mar 2027. Not combinable, no LinkPoints, non-refundable.
 Valid till 11 Nov 2026

 Why the early birds matter more this year 
 11 November 2026 is a Wednesday, so the brands that sell big-ticket items have moved their offers forward to the weekends either side of it. Two of the best deals in this guide (HipVan and Castlery) end a week before 11.11 itself. Lazada had not published its 2026 11.11 mechanics on its homepage when we checked on 30 October; its banners were still on the 28-31 October Smart Living Expo. 
 How to stack an 11.11 order 
 Claim platform vouchers before you shop. Shopee's big vouchers refill in waves and were already marked fully redeemed between drops. 
 Read the minimum-spend rule. HipVan counts its $250 after discounts; Castlery counts its tiers before shipping. 
 One code per order is the norm. Weavve and HipVan both say codes do not stack, so pick the bigger saving. 
 Check the 'was' price. A pre-sale discount is measured against the retailer's own list price; compare the model number elsewhere before you pay. 
 Finish with a cashback app and the right card. They add a layer on top of every deal here. 
 How we checked 
 Every price, code and date above was read from the brands' own websites on 30 October 2026: Shopee's 11.11 campaign page, HipVan's 11.11 landing page and banner, Castlery's sale page and promo terms, Secretlab's site banner and sale countdown, Weavve's sale collection, Lenskart's promotions page, BEST Denki's online promotions page and Wild Wild Wet's promotion page and terms. We re-checked every brand on 31 October: all eight offers are unchanged, and two details were added (Lenskart's code 1111 and Secretlab's sitewide and chair codes).

 Frequently Asked Questions
 When is the 11.11 sale in Singapore in 2026? + The main day is Wednesday 11 November 2026, but many offers start earlier. Shopee's 11.11 vouchers were already live on 30 October, HipVan's EARLY11 runs only until 2 November, Castlery's 11.11 Sale runs 26 October to 4 November, and Weavve's runs 28 October to 15 November.
 What are the Shopee 11.11 vouchers in 2026? + On 30 October 2026 Shopee's campaign page listed an all-categories $111 off a $350 spend, 20% off capped at $65 (min. $150), 20% off capped at $250 (min. $500), 15% coins cashback capped at 1,500 coins, and free shipping from $15. The big vouchers refill in waves, so claim them as soon as a new pool drops.
 Which 11.11 promo codes work in Singapore right now? + Codes we found on brands' own sites on 30 October 2026: EARLY11 at HipVan (11% off storewide on $250+, to 2 November), 11NOV15 at Weavve Home (15% off sitewide, to 15 November), SLEV-MINSW111126 at Secretlab ($120 off a $1,999 spend sitewide, sale to 12 November) and 1111 at Lenskart (Buy 1 Get 1 Free + 11% off Essentials frames). Castlery's tiers apply automatically without a code.
 Is it better to buy before 11.11 or on the day? + For furniture, buy before: HipVan and Castlery's 11.11 offers both end the week before. For platform vouchers on Shopee, the biggest drops usually come on the day at midnight, noon and 8pm. Day-only deals such as Wild Wild Wet's two passes for $29 go on sale at 11am on 11 November.
